notices.title: Managed service
notices.review: Continuing verified configuration; paid credits/plans/fallback prohibited; availability and free capacity not perpetual guarantees.
notices.display_predicate: Actual current plan/model/resource checks and declared verification validity; stale/failed/incompatible verification leaves managed routes disabled. This is not current deployment or perpetual billing certification.

notices.title: Public report service
notices.review: Account-free public route only after typed-summary/privacy/configuration proof. Public permanence disclosed. Actual bounded queue/purpose consent required; otherwise refuse.
notices.display_predicate: Strict typed summary actually excludes raw logs/settings/paths/personal text; owner zero-cost gate and independent report quotas implemented. Queue only if explicitly permitted by bounded storage/retry policy. Actual permitted bounded queue with disclosed stored content/location/retention/deletion/retry limits, valid purpose-specific consent and atomic request identity/reconciliation required; otherwise refuse. General notice is not acknowledgment of an actual queued request.

notices.title: Hosted diagnosis
notices.review: Account-free hosted technical summary only after route and allowlist proof. Advice not verified diagnosis or automatic execution. Public filing independent.
notices.display_predicate: Hosted selection/actual new request; typed input/privacy disclosure and opt-out; verified free model allowlist, atomic quota enforcement and no paid fallback. Reused advice does not imply a new transfer. Actual permitted bounded queue with disclosed stored content/location/retention/deletion/retry limits, valid purpose-specific consent and atomic request identity/reconciliation required; otherwise refuse. General notice is not acknowledgment of an actual queued request.

notices.title: Hosted chat
notices.review: Freeform/context sensitivity disclosed and explicitly reviewed; prior CLI history/log/settings not automatically transferred. Bounded queue predicate retained.
notices.display_predicate: Hosted mode selected, explicit context preview/consent and transfer boundary implemented, zero-cost verified, no arbitrary-text anonymity claim or automatic raw CLI history import. Actual permitted bounded queue with disclosed stored content/location/retention/deletion/retry limits, valid purpose-specific consent and atomic request identity/reconciliation required; otherwise refuse. General notice is not acknowledgment of an actual queued request.

notices.title: Free AI limit reached
notices.review: Confirmed quota refusal/no successful inference required; does not assert all transport cancelled. Independent reporting availability is conditional.
notices.display_predicate: Confirmed quota refusal without successful inference; no successful queued request promised; independent report route status actually checked. Do not assert all transport was cancelled.

notices.title: AI request queued
notices.review: Actual bounded consented/reconciled queue required. Removal only before another attempt; cannot undo earlier transfer; no paid resource selection.
notices.display_predicate: Actual permitted bounded queue exists with disclosed content/location/retention/deletion and retry limits; consent valid; server/client request identity reconciled. Never imply raw inputs or CLI history automatically saved.

notices.title: Report not accepted
notices.review: Authoritative reporting refusal only, not a timeout. Separate AI limits cannot establish filing.
notices.display_predicate: Explicit authoritative quota rejection proves no accepted filing for this attempt. Network timeout/unknown result must use ZC09 instead.

notices.title: Report queued
notices.review: Actual summary queue and prior-attempt reconciliation required; no filing by this queued attempt and no retraction of already public issue claimed.
notices.display_predicate: Actual permitted bounded summary queue; no submission yet for queued attempt; prior attempts reconciled/deduplicated. Queue retention and cancellation disclosed and implemented.

notices.title: Report result unknown
notices.review: Indeterminate acceptance proves neither filed nor nothing sent; identity reconciliation before retry, no paid fallback or upgrade.
notices.display_predicate: Actual indeterminate transport/outcome; reconciliation mechanism implemented. Do not claim complete anonymity, cancellation or guaranteed future filing.

notices.title: Zero-cost configuration unverified
notices.review: Unverified/stale/failed configuration leaves managed route disabled. Existing selected CLI account requirements remain separate.
notices.display_predicate: Owner configuration verification absent/stale/failed; application actually keeps managed route disabled. No deployment/free-plan certification implied.

notices.title: Zero-cost route unavailable
notices.review: Incompatible verified plan/model/limit leaves route disabled; no paid resources or silent CLI reconfiguration.
notices.display_predicate: Actual plan/model/limit check establishes incompatibility; preserve unrelated user configuration and do not silently alter other services.

notices.title: Zero-cost managed route
notices.review: Full hard-zero-cost boundary includes hosting/domains/plans/credits/fallback even with consent; continuing verification and bounded queue policy explicit.
notices.display_predicate: Actual current plan/model/resource checks and declared verification validity; stale/failed/incompatible verification leaves managed routes disabled. This is not current deployment or perpetual billing certification. Managed route refuses incompatible paid configuration regardless of user-facing confirmation; no paid resources/credits/domain/GPU rental/fallback/plan upgrades. Do not forbid explicit user choice of separately configured CLI, and do not claim guarantee for arbitrary user accounts. Queue only under implemented disclosed bounded purpose-specific content/location/retention/deletion/retry policy, valid consent and atomic request identity; otherwise refuse.

notices.title: Existing CLI provider
notices.review: Only explicitly selected user-owned CLI has its own account/subscription/transport terms; no automatic hosted exhaustion fallback.
notices.display_predicate: Existing CLI selected explicitly, correct provider account/terms disclosure; no claim every CLI remote/account-free/no-charge and no automatic quota fallback.

notices.title: Separate public and cloud choices
notices.review: Purpose-specific public/cloud settings, disclosure, consent and opt-outs independent; disabled purpose sends no network request.
notices.display_predicate: Actual separate settings/disclosures/consent and no network when each purpose disabled; valid new hosted request or explicit reuse distinction; account-free technical diagnosis and sensitive freeform chat remain separate payloads. State UI cancellation/timeout limits truthfully.
